		treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.004 }
	}
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_ARG_ucr_programme }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ARG_ucr_programme_stability_factor = 0.03 tooltip = COLDWAR_ARG_mod_stability_factor_tt }
	add_to_variable = {
		COLDWAR_ARG_ucr_programme_police_cost_multiplier_modifier = -0.03
		tooltip = COLDWAR_ARG_mod_police_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt
	}
	add_to_variable = {
		COLDWAR_ARG_ucr_programme_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.03
		tooltip = COLDWAR_ARG_mod_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt
	}
}

		treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.01 }
	}
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	set_temp_variable = {
		COLDWAR_ARG_weekly_amount = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.0005 divide = 52 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ARG_weekly_preview = COLDWAR_ARG_weekly_amount tooltip = COLDWAR_ARG_weekly_expense_tt }
	custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_ARG_economy_programme }
	add_to_variable = {
		COLDWAR_ARG_economy_programme_supply_consumption_factor = -0.03
		tooltip = COLDWAR_ARG_mod_supply_consumption_factor_tt
	}
	450 = {
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
	453 = {
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
}

	if = {

			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1

		}

COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_event_programmes = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ARG_event_weekly = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_1_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_1 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_1 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_2_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_2 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_2 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_2 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_3_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_3 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_3 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_3 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_commanders_3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_1_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_1 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_1 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_2_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_2 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_2 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_2 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_opening_2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_1_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_1 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_1 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_2_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_2 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_2 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_2 }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_popular_hour_2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_peronism_1_active neutrality_neutral_autocracy_are_in_power = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_peronism_1 }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_peronism_1 }
		}
	}
	else = {

COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_ARG_is_scenario = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = ENG }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_campaign
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_war_ended
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_campaign
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_war_ended }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_war_ended
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { owns_state = 26 controls_state = 26 }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_defeat
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
			}
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_war_mobilization
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_ARG_civilian_constitutional_government = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_constitutional_government }
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_start_regime
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_corporate_constitution
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { debt_ratio > 0.75 }
				OR = {
					has_active_mission = bankruptcy_incoming_collapse
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = very_high_interest_country_modifiers }
					check_variable = { interest_rate > 15 }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_debt_crisis_recorded }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_debt_crisis_recorded
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_debt_crisis
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date > 1970.5.28 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_montoneros_organized
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1974.7.1
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Juan Perón" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_post_peron_succession
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_ARG_is_scenario = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_ARG_1970_focus }
			}
			load_focus_tree = { tree = COLDWAR_ARG_1970_focus keep_completed = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_initialized
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_repression_occurred
			COLDWAR_ARG_initialize_politics = yes
			COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_ARG_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_ARG_is_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = yes
		COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = yes
		COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_politics = yes
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B6 24.11.2026: no polled succession or commanders events (leadership via focus fork)
		COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_ARG_add_weekly_income = {
	if = {
		limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_ARG_add_treaty_income = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_ARG_add_weekly_expenses = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_ARG_is_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_ARG_programme_weekly }
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_ARG_event_weekly }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_mobilization_funded has_war_with = ENG }
			set_temp_variable = {
				COLDWAR_ARG_weekly_amount = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.002 divide = 52 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_ARG_weekly_amount }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_ARG_add_treaty_expenses = yes
	}
}
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B6 24.11.2026: elected handover focus (effects of the former decision)
COLDWAR_ARG_preview_focus_civilian_handover = {
	set_temp_variable = {
		treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 }
	}
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_start_regime
	COLDWAR_ARG_transfer_to_elected_government = yes
}
COLDWAR_ARG_complete_civilian_handover = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_ARG_can_decide_civilian_handover = yes }
		set_temp_variable = {
			treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 }
		}
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_decision_civilian_handover_done
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_start_regime
		COLDWAR_ARG_transfer_to_elected_government = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_constitutional_government
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_corporate_constitution
		COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
